spans.s:
m. (-मिः)
The moon.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Struck, wounded, killed.
2 Repelled, repulsed, overcome, defeated.
3 Spread, expanded.
4 Contiguous, bounding, limitative.
5 Learned, accomplished.
E.
प्र again, and हत struck, injured.

m. (-रः)
A watch, an 8th part of the day, or a division comprising about three hours.
E.
प्र before हृ to take, घञ् aff.

m. (-रः)
1 Striking, wounding, killing.
2 A blow.
E.
प्र before हृ to take, aff. घञ्.

n. (-णं)
1 A weapon.
2 A covered car, a litter for women, or any litter, or small covered car for diversion.
3 War, battle.
4 Striking, killing.
E.
प्र before हृ to take, aff. ल्युट्.

n. (-णं)
A desirable gift.
E.
प्र before हृ to take, aff. ल्युट्; also प्रवारण.

f. (-का)
A species of the Śarkarī metre.

m. (-री)
A watchman, a bellman.
E.
प्रहर a watch, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-ष्यन्-ष्यन्ती-ष्यत्)
Taking, intending or wishing to take.
E.
प्र, हृ to take, with a future sense, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्त्री-र्त्तृ)
Striking, a striker, a combatant.
E.
प्र before हृ to take, तृच् aff.

m. (-र्षः)
Delight, joy, rapture.
E.
प्र before हृष to rejoice, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
1 Happy, delighted.
2 Delighting.
m. (-णः)
The planet Mercury, or its ruler.
f. (-णी)
1

Turmerick.
2

A form of metre.
E.
प्र before हृष to rejoice, aff. ल्युट्.

f. (-णी)
A species of the Atijagatī metre.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Delighted, very happy.
E.
प्र before हृष to rejoice, क्त aff.

mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सत्)
Laughing, laughing heartily.
f. (-न्ती)
Arabian jasmine.
E.
प्र before हस to smile, aff. शतृ; fem. aff. ङीप्.

n. (-नं)
1 Loud, violent or hearty laughter.
2 Mirth, merriment.
3 Sarcasm, satire, as a branch of rhetorical composition.
4 Reproof, ridicule, irony.
5 A farce, a comedy.
E.
प्र before हस to laugh, aff. ल्युट्.

n. (-तं)
Laughter, mirth.
E.
प्र and हस to laugh, क्त aff.

m. (-स्तः)
The open hand with the fingers extended.
E.
प्र exchanging, हस्त the hand.

n. (-णं)
Driving away, forced abandonment or departure.
E.
प्र before हा to quit, causal v., ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं)
Bruised, wounded, hurt by a blow.
n. (-र्त्तं)
Lasting and acute pain from a wound or maim.
E.
प्रहार striking, and आर्त्त pained.

m. (-सः)
1 Loud laughter.
2 Blowing, (as a flower.)
3 Ś

IVA.
4

An actor, a dancer.
5 A place of pilgrimage; also सोमतीर्थ.
E.
प्र before हस to laugh, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि)
1 Laughing aloud.
2 Diverting, causing laughter.
m. (-सी)
A jester, a buffoon, a clown.
E.
प्र before हस to laugh, aff. णिनि.

m. (-हिः)
A well.
E.
प्र before हृ to take, Uṇādi aff. इन्, and the final of the radical rejected.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Sent, dispatched.
2 Appointed, commissioned.
3 Stretched out, extended.
4

Placed.
5

Discharged, as an arrow from a bow.
6

Learned.
7

Suitable, appropriate.
n. (-तं)
Sauce, gravy, condiment.
E.
प्र before हित proper.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Left, abandoned.
m. (-णः)
Removal, loss, waste, destruction.
E.
प्र before हा to quit, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Dead, slain.
E.
प्रहीण, and जीवित life.

n. (-तं)
Offering articles of food to spirits or goblins.
E.
प्र before हुत the same.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Seized.
n. (-तं)
Striking, killing.
E.
प्र, and हृत taken.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Pleased, delighted.
E.
प्र before हृष to be pleased, aff. क्त.

m. (-कः)
A crow.
E.
प्र before हृष्ट pleased, aff. कन्.

n. (-कं)
Victuals or sweetmeats, &c. distributed at festivals.

n. (-कं)
Sweetmeats, &c. distributed at festivals.

f. (-का)
An enigma, a riddle, a puzzling or enigmatical question.
E.
प्र before हिल to play, and ण्वुल् aff.

m. (-दः)
A prince: see प्रह्लाद.
E.
ल changed to र.

f. (-त्तिः)
Pleasure, happiness.
E.
प्र before ह्लद to be glad, क्तिन् aff.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
Pleased, happy, glad.
E.
प्र before ह्लाद to be happy, क्त aff.

f. (-न्निः)
Pleasure, delight.
E.
प्र before ह्लद to be happy, क्तिन् aff.

m. (-दः)
1 Pleasure, joy, happiness.
2 Sound, noise.
3 The name of HIRAṆYĀKṢA'S pious son and regent of one division of Pātāla.
E.
प्र before ह्लाद gladness or sound.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Rejoiced, delighted.
E.
प्रह्लाद to be happy, क्त aff.

mfn. (-ह्वः-ह्वा-ह्वं)
1 Bowed, bent, stooping.
2 Intent upon, engaged in, engrossed by.
E.
प्र before ह्वेञ् to call, Uṇādi aff. वन्, form irr.

mfn. (-लिः-लिः-लि)
Stooping or bowing with the palm of the hands joined, and put to the forehead in token of respect.
E.
प्रह्व, and अञ्जलि salute.

m. (-यः)
Calling, summoning, invocation.
E.
प्र before ह्वे to call, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Conquered, won, subjected.
2 Bent, bowed.
E.
प्रह्व, and कृत made, च्चि aff.

m. (-हः)
Instruction in the art of acting or dancing.

m. (-ह्णः)
The forenoon.
E.
प्र prior, अह्न the day.

ind.
In the morning, in the forenoon.
E.
the seventh case of the last word, used as a particle.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Belonging to the forenoon.
E.
प्राह्णे in the morning, aff. द्यु, and तुक aug.

ind.
Early in the day, in the forenoon.
E.
प्राह्णे with तमप् aff. and आमु added.
